sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with an Idoneth Deepkin army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Idoneth Deepkin units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using.
They can be your warlord.
There are 8 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Choose an Archetype.
4. Choose a Companion.
5. Pick your hero’s origin and/or flaw.
6. Choose a Battle Mount.
7. Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
8. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Young Noble | 10 | 150
Lord of the Enclave | 30 | 250
Ethersea Regent | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.text:
You must pick 1 of the following Archetypes for your hero:

0DP

Regiment Options | Any IDONETH DEEPKIN units
In addition, change the characteristics of your hero’s Thalassic Weapon to the following:

Thalassic Weapon | 5 | 3+ | 4+ | 1 | 2
Isharann

sections.name: Step 4 - Choose a Companion
sections.text:
You can pick up to 1 Companion for your hero:
Companion
-1DP
SHOAL OF ZEPHYRFISH: The razor-sharp jaws of the Zephyrfish can cause grievous wounds.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
RANGED WEAPONS | Rng | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Shoal of Zephyrfish
Shoot in Combat, Companion | 10" | 8 | 4+ | 5+ | 1 | 1
Companion
-2DP
ABYSSAL CEPHALOPOD: Ochtars and other deep-sea cephalopods are highly intelligent and protective creatures.
INFANTRY only. Add the following abilities to your hero’s warscroll:
Passive
ABYSSAL CEPHALOPOD Effect: This unit’s Abyssal Cephalopod is a token. If it is removed from the battlefield, this unit cannot use the 'Pelagic Defender' ability.
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
PELAGIC DEFENDER Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:
Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll 8 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
This unit has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.
After resolving either effect, remove this unit’s Abyssal Cephalopod from the battlefield.
Companion
-2DP
SEA-BEAST FAMILIAR: From the deadly Spinefin to the mysterious Phantasmaray, there are a host of sea creatures that accompany Idoneth heroes to battle and help them in various ways.
INFANTRY only. Add the following abilities to your hero’s warscroll:
Passive
SEA-BEAST FAMILIAR Effect: This unit’s Sea-beast Familiar is a token. If it is removed from the battlefield, this unit cannot use the ’Deep-sea Aid’ ability.
Passive
DEEP-SEA AID Effect: You can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll, 1 save roll, 1 ward roll, 1 casting roll or 1 unbinding roll for this unit. After you have done so, remove this unit’s Sea-beast Familiar from the battlefield.

sections.name: Step 5 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.name: Origins
sections.text:
Passive
-1DP
ROYAL LINEAGE
Effect: Add 1 to the control scores of friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Passive
-2DP
PRODIGY OF THE ASYDRAZOR
Effect: If this unit is AKHELIAN, add a number equal to the number of ranks this unit has earned on its Path to the Attacks characteristic of its Thalassic Weapon.
For example, if this unit has earned the Legendary rank on its Path, add 4 to the Attacks characteristic of its Thalassic Weapon.
Any Combat Phase
-4DP
SWIFT AS THE GREAT CURRENT
Effect: Roll a dice. Add 2 to the roll if this unit is INFANTRY. On a 4+, this unit has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.
Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for this unit
-2DP
PRODIGY OF THE TURSCOLL
Effect: If this unit is ISHARANN, re-roll 1 of the dice in the casting roll.

sections.name: Flaws
sections.text:
End of Any Turn
+4DP
LEGACY OF SLAANESH
Declare: This unit must use this ability at the end of each turn.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (a ward roll cannot be made for that damage point).
Passive
+2DP
PRIDE AND ARROGANCE
Effect: While this unit is in combat with any enemy HEROES, all of its combat attacks must target an enemy HERO.
Passive
+2DP
OVERLY CAUTIOUS
Effect: Each time this unit is targeted by an attack, if you have any command points and a friendly unit has not already used the’ All-out Defence’ command this phase, this unit must use the’ All-out Defence’ command.
Passive
+4DP
ISOLATIONIST
Effect: This unit cannot be set up within 9" of any friendly units. In addition, friendly units cannot be set up within 9" of this unit.

sections.name: Step 6 - Choose a Battle Mount
sections.text:
You can pick up to 1 Battle Mount for your hero.
Battle Mount
-5DP
SEA-STEED: From the Fangmora Eels to the resplendent Deepmares, many are the sea creatures that the Idoneth have trained to be effective mounts.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Sea-steed's Fangs | 4 | 4+ | 3+ | 1 | 2
In addition, make the fo llowing changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 12".
Change the Health characteristic to 7.
Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the following keywords: CAVALRY, FLY.
Battle Mount
-8DP
ALLOPEX: Swift, aggressive and utterly merciless, an Allopex is the perfect companion for an Idoneth who thrives on bloodshed.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Allopex’s Ferocious Bite
Anti- MONSTER (+1 Rend), Companion | 3 | 4+ | 2+ | 2 | 2
Passive
BLOODTHIRSTY PREDATORS
Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Allopex’s Ferocious Bite while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 12".
Change the Health characteristic to 10.
Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the following keywords: CAVALRY, FLY.
Battle Mount
-25DP
MIGHTY SEA-BEAST: The most skilled Ido neth can harness a titan of the sea to bear them to battle, whether that be a colossal Leviadon or one of the more esoteric creatures that lurk in the depths.
Add the following weapon and ability to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Mighty Sea-beast’s Jaws
Companion | 6 | 4+ | 2+ | 2 | 3
Passive
BATTLE DAMAGED Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mighty Sea-beast’s Jaws is 3.
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 10".
Change the Health characteristic to 16.
Change the Save characteristic to 3+.
Change the Control characteristic to 5.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the following keywords: MONSTER, FLY.

sections.text:
If your hero has a Battle Mount, you can pick any number of Battle Mount Upgrades for them. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.

Declare: If the unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Mounted Crew
-10DP
MONSTER only. Add the following weapons to your hero’s warscroll:
RANGED WEAPONS | Rng | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg

MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg

Void Drummer
-5DP
MONSTER only. Your hero has WARD (5+).
Clamping Bite

MONSTER only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll. You cannot pick this upgrade if your hero has another RAMPAGE ability.
Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
CLAMPING BITE
Declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER within 1" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+. inflict 3 mortal damage on the target. In addition, on a 6, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

sections.name: Path of The Perpetual Deep
sections.text:
(IDONETH DEEPKIN HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
BLADE OF THE CYTHAI
Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
Passive
BLESSING OF MATHLANN
Effect: This unit has WARD (6+).
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
VOID STRIKE
Effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the turn.
End of Any Turn
SOUL STEALER
Effect: If this unit is in combat, Heal (D3) this unit.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
RAPID ATTACKER
Effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
GUARDIAN OF THE PHALANX
Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to save rolls for this unit and friendly NAMARTI units while they are within this unit’s combat range.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Any Combat Phase
PARAGON OF BATTLE
Effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons. Add D3 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the turn.
Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
RIDE THE MAELSTROM
Effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

sections.name: Path of The Enclave
sections.text:
(non- HERO IDONETH DEEPKIN unit only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
REAPING STRIKES
Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target enemy INFANTRY units.
Passive
SWIFT SEA-RAIDERS
Effect: Add 1" to this unit's Move characteristic.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
DEEP STALKERS
Effect: If this unit is a non- reinforced, non- MONSTER unit, it is not visible to enemy units more than 12" from it.
If this unit is a reinforced unit or a MONSTER, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit made by units more than 12" from it.
Deployment Phase
THE FIRST WAVE
Effect: This unit can immediately use the’ Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
FURY OF THE SEA
Effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for this unit.
Passive
FURY OF THE STORM
Effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits).
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick l of the following abilities for them:
Passive
THE CRASHING WAVE
Effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST.
Passive
GUARDED STANCE
Effect: This unit has WARD (5+) against damage points inflicted by combat attacks if it has not used a FIGHT ability in the same phase.
